newsitem.title: URUGUAY: Uruguay inflation fell to 1.2 pct in November.
newsitem.headline: Uruguay inflation fell to 1.2 pct in November.

text.p: Uruguay consumer prices rose 1.20 percent in November, down from 1.58 percent in October and 1.95 percent in November 1995, the National Statistics Institute said Thursday.
November's inflation took to 22.83 percent the increase in the first 11 months of 1996, against 32.57 in the same period last year.
In the 12 months to November, consumer prices rose 25.48 percent, below the 36.84 percent in the 12 months to November 1995, the institute said.
The Uruguay government reported an inflation rate of 35.4 percent in 1995, and expects to end 1996 with a 25.0 percent rate.
